newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firms net PLN 3.7 bln in Jan-April - GUS.
newsitem.headline: Polish firms net PLN 3.7 bln in Jan-April - GUS.

text.p: Polish enterprises reported an overall 3.7 billion zloty net profit in the January-April period, compared with a 3.4 billion zloty net profit in the same period of 1996, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
GUS said the private sector had a net profit of two billion zlotys on total revenues of 107 billion in the period against a profit of 1.4 billion and sales of 73.9 in the same period last year.
The state-owned sector reported a profit of 1.7 billion on sales of 95.8 billion versus last year's two billion and 85 billion respectively.

NOTES: Data collected from all companies employing more than 50 people in main sectors of the economy. Liquidity ratio is a percentage relation of cash reserves and tradable securities to short-term liabilities. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
